main_text.head: Amat. THEANO EVRIDICÆ III.
main_text.p: Naturalis decor in te prateriit, & vicina rugis eft facies. tu vero fingere veritatem niteris, fuppo- fitis pigmentis amatores eludendo. Concede tem- pori anicula. neque enim fpeciofa ftant floribus in fenectute prata. memento & mortis,cui appropin- quafti, & temperantiam ex neceffitate inftituas ex- colere. Eteniminiuria afficis & fenectutem & iu- uentam : quarum hanc dum fimulas, ementita es; illam,dum habes interpolafti.
main_text.head: Eth. EVAGORAS ANTIPATRO. IV.
main_text.p: Terminos mundi opifex marino quoque æftuí conftituit,& littoribus pelagius cohibetur fluctus: & arena quædam paruo interftitio continentem difcriminat à mari. Neque enim conceflum eft ma- ri periculum aliquod inferre vicinæ terræ: fed re- curritac reuoluitur in fe fua per furentia veftigia, magnam terræ minitans cluuionem. Terminos igitur & leges, ô Antipater,animo tuo pone, nec manum adbibeas ad iram. Et verò eodem modo cum manibus, modefte philofophiceque linguam inftituere fummus,gradus eft perfectæ virtutis.Sed fi non par fis huic moderandæ, quantiuis contu- melis animum tuum oblecta, fi can.bus[?] adfimula- ri volueris latrantibus. Sic enim iratum quoque mare, iram vltra fpumam & agitationem non pro- ducit.

page.notes: Page number 65 read from the top right; the digit is slightly smudged. The word "curritac" is as printed (likely a printing error for "currit ac"). "can.bus" is partly obscured by a stain; the reading "canibus" is probable but not certain. The final "E" and "Ruff." at the foot are read as signature and catchword. Show-through is present and was left out.
